description: Check-in poster vectors (protocol/checkin.md): version byte and CBOR body, text form atalaia:checkin: + base64url. Every valid payload decodes to its fields (bytes in hex, absent optionals null) and re-encodes byte for byte to the same payload and text. Every invalid one fails with its reason (length, version or body); every invalid text with reason text. optional_keys_skipped and spaces_around decode like the vector they name. declarations and identities are checked by the controller and the app alike.

optional_keys_skipped.name: optional_keys_skipped
optional_keys_skipped.why: keys 7 and 31 are kept for optional fields: skipped

invalid.name: version_only
invalid.why: a version byte and no body

invalid.name: ca_as_text
invalid.why: the fingerprint is a byte string

invalid.name: field_id_space
invalid.why: a space is not allowed in an id

invalid.name: url_http
invalid.why: only https: the app pins the CA

invalid.name: game_float
invalid.why: game_id is an integer, not a float

invalid.name: game_null
invalid.why: null is not a game id

same.name: spaces_around
same.why: spaces and line ends around the text are ignored

invalid.name: one_char_left
invalid.why: a length of 4n+1 is not base64

invalid.name: not_canonical
invalid.why: the unused bits are not zero

invalid.name: state_from_client
invalid.why: only the controller keeps the state

tickets.description: Check-in ticket vectors (protocol/checkin.md): version byte and CBOR body {1: registration_id, 2: player_id, 3: secret}, text form atalaia:ticket: + base64url. Built byte by byte from RFC 8949's encoding rules, not by the codecs. Every valid payload decodes to its fields (the secret in hex), re-encodes byte for byte and gives its text; secret_sha256 is SHA-256 of the secret in hex, as the roster carries it. optional_keys_skipped decodes like basic. Every invalid payload fails with its reason; every invalid text with reason text.

invalid.name: version_only
invalid.why: a version byte and no body

invalid.name: over_128_bytes
invalid.why: a skipped key makes it 129 bytes

invalid.name: secret_as_text
invalid.why: the secret is a byte string

invalid.name: registration_not_uuid
invalid.why: the UUID's canonical form, with hyphens

same.name: spaces_around
same.why: spaces and line ends around the text are ignored

invalid.name: not_canonical
invalid.why: unused bits set in the last character

poster_addresses.description: Which addresses the check-in poster lists and the server certificate covers (decisions check-R8, check-R9). input: tls_names ([api] tls_names, the Pi only), found (the host's names and addresses now, best first), interfaces (the IP addresses on an interface now), tls_port, container, saved_urls (the saved poster's), checkin_urls ([checkin] urls). expected: poster (the https urls listed, at most 3), dropped (configured addresses left out because they are on no interface, in the order saved_urls, checkin_urls, tls_names), san (the names the certificate covers, as a set: always a superset of the poster's hosts). A name is never dropped; an IP literal is kept if it is on an interface (or in a container). controller/atalaia_controller/addresses.py and app/lib/controller/field_addresses.dart both pass it.

cases.name: current_address_present
cases.why: a configured address that is on an interface now is listed, first

cases.name: stale_configured_address_dropped
cases.why: a configured address on no interface is left out of the poster and the certificate, and named in dropped

cases.name: configured_name_kept
cases.why: a host name cannot be checked against interfaces: it stays, before the addresses found

cases.name: saved_poster_stale_is_rederived
cases.why: a saved poster whose only address is stale is not kept: the poster is the default again

cases.name: saved_poster_partly_kept
cases.why: the GM's list loses its stale address and is not padded with others

cases.name: saved_poster_hostname_kept
cases.why: a name typed by the GM stays and its host is in the certificate (a superset of the poster)

cases.name: checkin_urls_ip_dropped_name_kept
cases.why: [checkin] urls: an IP not on an interface is dropped and warned about, a name stays

cases.name: saved_stale_falls_to_checkin_urls
cases.why: the saved poster is stale: [checkin] urls is tried next, then the default

cases.name: container_keeps_configured
cases.why: in a container the interfaces are the container's own: a configured address cannot be checked and stays; nothing found is listed (OT-10)

cases.name: ipv6_and_port_443
cases.why: an IPv6 address on an interface is kept, in brackets; port 443 is left out of the url

cases.name: three_at_most
cases.why: the default has at most 3 addresses

cases.name: found_loopback_and_link_local_not_listed
cases.why: what is found is listed only if another device can use it; the certificate still covers it

poster_change.description: Whether the poster now differs from the one last printed (decision check-R8: the console says "the poster changed" and suggests printing it again). input: printed (the urls and CA, as hex, of the poster the GM last printed, or null), urls (the poster's now), ca_sha256 (the field CA's now, hex; null when HTTPS is off). expected: null (nothing to say: nothing printed yet, no poster now, or the same addresses in any order and the same CA) or {added, removed, ca_changed, still_works}: still_works is true when the CA is the same and at least one printed address is still listed, so the printed poster still reaches the controller. controller/atalaia_controller/checkin.py (poster_change) and app/lib/controller/controller_checkin.dart (posterChange) both pass it.

cases.name: an address gone, another still there
